comment: She is really really really smart! The material and the presentation made me think about things in different ways. Get ready to be challenged!

This is the first year of Africana studies so there is room for improvement to build a stronger syllabus and organize the content better. That being said, I didn't love the class nor did I dislike it. It was lecture heavy & not that engaging. Dr Meyer is super nice however, but can grade rather hardly.

Dr. Meyer is incredible! She is knowledge about the material, knows how to foster an engaging discussion (even over Zoom!!!!), and is overall a very understanding and caring professor. Do the readings and participate in class and you will do well! When it comes to the written assignments for this class, if you work hard, it will pay off.

I really enjoyed Professor Meyer's Borderlands class. I decided to take this class bc it filled my history requirement and her reviews looked decent on here, lol. So if you are like me, here is your sign to take her class. My advice: participate a lot & don't read every page of the assigned reading (you can easily get away without reading).

Dr. Meyer is honestly one of the most knowledgeable professors at UR. Her Borderlands course is a great way to satisfy the history credit. There is a lot of reading sometimes, but her lectures are very interesting (and timely). She assigns two papers that are only 3-5 pages and her midterm and final were pretty simple. She's amazing!!

This is not a debate class, Meyer makes it very clear from the beginning. The class is very reading heavy and requires you to print the readings and bring them to class. There are about four papers including the midterm and final, they are 3-5 pg essays that only require you to look at one reading (super easy). Class participation matters a lot

I took Borderlands to fulfill GenEd requirements, but I'm now considering a history minor. Dr. Meyer's class was thought-provoking and challenging, but not so challenging that I felt an A was out of reach. She offers opportunities for extra credit and is more than willing to go over papers in office hours. lots of reading but pretty interesting.
Love, love, love her. Super engaging, smart, and very helpful. I'm going to her for help with papers and she was very helpful. Would definitely take again!

Must be both a great writer and a great participator to do well in her class, if you are missing either this class will be rough for you. Unrealistically high expectations for class participation and an insane amount of printing credits are used. Fast lectures on info that isnt even tested but it is certainly an interesting course.

Dr. Meyer is a great professor, but WOW SHE TALKS QUICKLY! If you do not like to take constant notes, I would not suggest taking this course. I was able to pass with a B (unless I fail my final essay) without reading the homework assignments until I needed to write a paper about them. There is a ton of reading. I repeat- A TON. But she is good ovr.

I love her energy. I'm taking this upper level history course on madness and psychiatry. Not only really interesting topic, but Meyer is a great professor who is super knowledgeable! Highly recommend.

Reading intensive class that requires you to use a lot of print credits. We had 4 papers over the semester. I went in to speak with her about all of them and she was super helpful with developing my thesis and argument. Really cares about students and her topic. I put in a lot of effort for the papers, but it was not impossible.
She makes the history of Latin America really interesting. And she's funny.  Would definitely take a class with her again.  And she's adorable.

Definitely will make you work for it, this borderlands class only has 4 papers but she'll read your drafts for you. Class is heavily discussion based, must read the reading for the day to participate in class. Participation grade means a lot to her and she can really make your grade lower if you do not participate in class. Would take again.

She's an absolute genius in her field: she had to skip class to go talk to Congress. Class is an hour long discussion and you have to talk or you'll take a real hit on your grade. That being said, one of the best classes I've taken at UR.

Dr. Meyer was my favorite professor this semester. Her class has been well thought out and well prepared. Dr. Meyer expects a lot out of her students in this Borderlands class, thus doing the (many) readings is vital, and trust me she can tell if you didn't do them. Meeting with her is so helpful, and she is so genuine. Great 9 A.M. professor also

Lot's of reading for class but is very thorough in discussions and clearly is very very knowledgeable about latin american history. Very engaging and encourages a lot of class participation. Can be very wordy and a bit vague at times but she's very nice and helpful. You really need to do the readings for class.

Very clear and interesting lectures. Lots of reading but she does an amazing job of covering the text in class. Heavy on participation but lenient if you do well in other aspects of the class. Easy grader on papers and leaves great feedback. Would take another course under her.

This professor was very interesting but very difficult especially for a 100 level course. There is a large amount of reading and outside of class preparation. Grades are mostly papers that are expected to be perfect.

I have Prof. Meyer for my FYS on the US-Mexico border.  She's very smart and obviously cares alot about the subject.  She's always willing to meet with students to help them out and leads class discussions really well.  I highly recommend her.  She really wants students to do well.

I had her for my freshman seminar (Contested Terrain), and overall Prof. Meyer is a pretty cool teacher. She's always willing to help her students out, and she leads discussions well. Although, she does hand out a lot of reading.
Professor Meyer is ridiculously smart and super helpful.  She expects alot from freshmen though...

TOO MUCH READING! no quizzes or exams though. just essays and seminar-style discussion. Professor Meyer is adorable in class (best hair ever) butwhen you're doing her readings she's easy to hate. I would not take this class twice. (FYS: Contested Terrain)
